segments.name: Fiber-optic networking products
segments.description: Design and manufacture fiber-optic networking products for internet data center, CATV, telecom and FTTH markets.
segments.evidence: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. (the "Company" or "AOI") is a leading, vertically integrated provider of fiber-optic networking products, primarily for four networking end-markets: internet data center, cable television ("CATV"), telecommunications, ("telecom"), and fiber-to-the-home ("FTTH").

revenueModel.text: Customers including hyperscale data center operators, CATV equipment vendors, MSOs, network equipment manufacturers and telecom service providers purchase optical networking products for infrastructure and connectivity.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers in this market are generally large internet-based ("hyperscale") data center operators, along with equipment suppliers who supply our products along with others to our hyperscale data center operator customers.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company began offering CATV products directly to MSO customers under the Quantum Bandwidth brand name instead of solely through equipment vendors.
changes.evidence: In 2023, we began offering many of our CATV products directly to MSO customers, under Quantum Bandwidth™ brand name.
